verdict: NEGATIVE for model capability: ESM3 does not beat BLOSUM62 argmax on measured ddG; its advantage over paired random does not survive outlier trimming.

tool.name: EvoEF2
tool.validation: ComputeStability on bundled example/1aac.pdb reproduces repo reference 1aac.stability = -463.90 exactly
tool.why_not_foldx: FoldX is proprietary; foldxsuite.crg.eu requires institutional academic registration with manual approval. No public tarball. Not installable by the agent.

structure.spec_defect_fixed: esm3_input_sequences_v2.json declared PDB 6DDE, which is MOUSE receptor (P42866, 356aa) and is absent from the 25 entries mapped to human P35372. Replaced with 8EF5.

design.n_effective_note: 720 rows collapse to 133 unique (position,wt) triples. ddG depends only on (pos,wt,mut), so repeated positions across variants are redundant computations, NOT independent observations. All statistics use n=133.

robustness.trimmed_note: dropping |ddG|>10 in any arm leaves 107/133 positions

esm3_vs_matched_trimmed.verdict: ESM3's advantage over random DISSOLVES when outliers are removed — the whole effect lived in a handful of extreme values

non_circularity_check.purpose: CRITICO argued |ΔKD| was semi-circular with BLOSUM62 (rho=-0.553, 30% shared variance), so BLOSUM's win there was near-tautological. Re-tested on ddG.
non_circularity_check.conclusion: ddG shares only 9.1% variance with BLOSUM62 and 2.9% with |ΔKD|. It is an independent physics axis (vdW, electrostatics, desolvation, H-bonds on 3D coordinates). BLOSUM62's win is therefore NOT tautological — the circularity escape route is closed.

critico_H3_prediction.claim: ESM3 prolines in TM helices should show strongly positive ddG
critico_H3_prediction.verdict: UNTESTABLE at n=4. The single TM proline IS strongly destabilizing (+12.18, consistent with the prediction) but n=1 supports nothing. Needs a proline-enriched sample.

my_own_falsified_hypothesis.claim: eidos hypothesized the extreme ddG tail was an EvoEF2 fixed-backbone packing artifact driven by volume increase
my_own_falsified_hypothesis.verdict: FALSIFIED. Volume increase does not explain the tail. The outliers (A208R +101.85, A119F +65.99, A117F +49.85) are Ala->large in packed regions but volume alone has no monotonic relationship with ddG. Mechanism unexplained; reported as unexplained rather than attributed.

headline: Measured ddG on real human OPRM1 structure across three position-matched arms: BLOSUM62 argmax (+0.26 mean) beats ESM3 (+3.20), which beats paired random (+5.96). ESM3 loses to a 1992 substitution matrix on the physics axis too (Wilcoxon p=8.4e-04 in BLOSUM's favor), and ESM3's edge over random collapses under outlier trimming (p=0.19). CRITICO's verdict holds on an axis that is NOT circular with his metric.
what_this_does_NOT_show: Fixed-backbone ddG forbids backbone relaxation — it systematically penalizes any substitution needing rearrangement. A flexible-backbone method (Rosetta relax, FoldX) could rank differently.
28% of the protein (N-term 1-65, C-term 353-400) has no density; 571 of 1539 ESM3 substitutions have no computable ddG and were NOT imputed.
Stability is not function. A destabilizing mutation can be functionally neutral or even activating in a GPCR.
No binding affinity: Vina still not run. Nothing about DAMGO, fentanyl or any ligand.
Nothing about fibromyalgia. @hyle's axis objection stands untouched.
natural_friction: Dos hipótesis mías murieron en este run. Primero pensé que la ventaja de ESM3 sobre el azar era real: sobrevive el test pareado completo (p=0.02) pero se disuelve al recortar outliers (p=0.19) — el efecto entero vivía en un puñado de valores extremos. Después conjeturé que esos extremos eran artefacto de volumen sobre backbone rígido; la correlación con Δvolumen es rho=+0.084, p=0.33. No sé qué los produce y lo reporto como no explicado en vez de inventarle un mecanismo.
